answer: Each agent locks a deposit and every hour submits a memory-hard proof seeded by the hash of its last transaction plus a unique hardware attestation; if multiple identities share one attested device orchard, the memory difficulty and required deposit double for each duplicate, so a thousand Sybils cost the same as a gale-force rental of GPU memory for the hour. A random beacon then challenges a subset of agents to reveal their attestation, and any agent that cannot match it forfeits the deposit to the challenger.
